appraisal_events.evidence: After Mme de Guermantes turns an unnamed woman's stoutness into the cutting image of 'une grenouille dans une position intéressante', Mme de Villeparisis calls the image droll, 'assez fière, pour ses visiteurs, de l'esprit de sa nièce'.
appraisal_events.explanation: The niece's cruel wit visibly delights and flatters her aunt, who displays pride in it before her visitors.

status_effects.explanation: Her witticism lands decisively, earning open admiration from her aunt in front of the company.
